treatments.summaryHtml:

For patients with severe arthritis or knee damage, total knee replacement surgery is often the best solution when other treatments no longer help. As the best hospital for total knee replacement in Ghaziabad, Amicare Hospital provides both traditional and robotic TKR surgery. These advanced techniques ensure precise implant placement, reduced pain, and quicker recovery, helping patients return to normal life faster. With experienced surgeons and modern facilities, Amicare is trusted for affordable knee replacement surgery in Ghaziabad. From consultation to rehabilitation, patients receive complete care and long-term relief, making it the preferred choice for TKR surgery.

Total Knee Replacement (TKR), also known as total knee arthroplasty, is a surgical procedure in
which the damaged surfaces of the knee joint are replaced with artificial implants. This
procedure is a key solution for patients seeking relief from chronic knee pain and improving
knee joint mobility.

treatments.title: Shoulder Care Treatment
treatments.summaryHtml:
Shoulder injuries can significantly impact your daily life by limiting mobility and causing persistent pain. At Amicare Hospital, Ghaziabad, we provide advanced diagnostics, expert orthopedic care, and personalized rehabilitation plans for all types of shoulder injuries. Whether it’s a sports injury, rotator cuff tear, or shoulder dislocation, our team ensures you receive the most effective and minimally invasive treatment possible.

The shoulder is a complex joint that allows a wide range of motion. Injuries can occur due to trauma, overuse, aging, or degenerative conditions.
highlights: Rotator Cuff Tears : Partial or complete tear of muscles/tendons that stabilize the shoulder.
Shoulder Dislocation : When the upper arm bone pops out of the shoulder socket.
Frozen Shoulder (Adhesive Capsulitis) : Stiffness and pain due to inflammation and scar tissue.
Shoulder Impingement Syndrome : Compression of tendons or bursa leading to pain and reduced mobility.
Labral Tears : Tear in the cartilage that stabilizes the shoulder joint.

technology.label: Robotic Joint Replacement
technology.heading: What Is Robotic Knee Replacement?
technology.html:
Robotic knee replacement is a next-generation surgical procedure in which an advanced robotic arm assists the surgeon in placing a knee implant with extraordinary accuracy. Unlike conventional knee replacement, where measurements depend entirely on manual technique, robotic-assisted surgery uses pre-operative 3D imaging and real-time data to guide every cut and placement.

In a robotic total knee replacement surgery, the robotic system creates a personalised surgical plan based on your unique anatomy. During the operation, the robotic arm helps the surgeon stay within pre-defined boundaries, reducing the risk of errors and ensuring the implant fits perfectly. This results in better alignment, less pain after surgery, and a faster return to normal activities.

Robotic knee replacement is recommended for patients suffering from severe osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, post-traumatic arthritis, or significant joint damage that has not responded to conservative treatments.
